notes: Use scoped page/context emulate({ extraHTTPHeaders }) or context creation emulation. Registrations replace the map within their scope; page headers merge over context headers. Removal restores the previous map. Request route overrides take precedence; invalid headers fail with InvalidInput.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: Each registration replaces the map within its scope; page headers merge over context headers, with page values winning when names match.
